item.description: ### Fixed - **The lock-screen countdown no longer restarts while an agent waits for you.** When other parts of a session kept working while one part waited for approval, the "time to answer" on your iPhone's Live Activity kept jumping back up, and could still show time left after the request had timed out. It now counts from when the wait began. - **A lock-screen card that can't be updated no longer lingers.** A Live Activity that Perch started while the iPhone app was closed could keep showing "needs you" for up to an hour after you'd answered. It now fades after ten minutes if Perch can't reach it.
